```sh

```

| [`bronto slack create`](/reference/commands/slack/#bronto-slack-create) | Create a Slack integration |

## bronto slack create

Create a Slack integration

```sh
bronto slack create [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | key=value pair for the request body (repeatable) |
| `--input` |  | string |  | request body from file, or - for stdin |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto slack create -f name=x -f limit=10
bronto slack create --input body.json
```
